name: Referring practice meeting brief
summary: Before meeting a referring office that has raised handoff problems, the practice liaison gets one brief: what was promised to that office and whether each promise was kept, the questions its staff keep asking, counted by topic, and a proposed agenda. Counts only, no patient detail; the liaison decides.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of healthcare administrative work, and its own rules for prepared work: the practice's own logs as the only evidence of a kept commitment, counts in place of patient detail, services described only in approved wording, and a liaison who chooses the agenda after each service owner has confirmed what may be offered.
